title: WasmModuleRuntimeAdapter
responsibility: Runs a compiled or precompiled core Wasm module that implements the Harness JSON ABI, without touching a file system.

inputs.name: wasmUnavailable.message
inputs.description: Text used as the message when wasmUnavailable creates its named error. The missing-export path supplies the Harness ABI explanation, while direct callers may provide any string.
examples: Wasm module does not export the Harness JSON ABI (memory, harness_alloc, harness_free, harness_invoke)

inputs.name: WasmModuleRuntimeAdapter.constructor.source
inputs.description: Provides a precompiled WebAssembly.Module, module bytes, or a loader that returns either synchronously or asynchronously. Byte sources are compiled when first loaded, and the adapter does not read a file.

inputs.name: WasmModuleRuntimeAdapter.constructor.options
inputs.description: Sets the per-call deadline through timeoutMs; asynchronous loading can time out, but synchronous WebAssembly work on this thread cannot be interrupted and a late result is discarded when the work returns. Defaults to {} and uses defaultRuntimeTimeoutMs (30,000 ms) when timeoutMs is absent or null.

inputs.name: WasmModuleRuntimeAdapter.invoke.request
inputs.description: Names the requested operation and may include its input in the optional input field; invoke checks the request for portable JSON before serialization. Non-finite numbers, ill-formed strings, non-plain objects, or nesting beyond 64 levels resolve as invalid-json.

inputs.name: WasmModuleRuntimeAdapter.invokeText.text
inputs.description: Raw request text encoded and sent through the module ABI. This method does not parse or validate the text, so the caller must provide content the module understands.

outputs.name: wasmUnavailable
outputs.description: Returns an Error named RuntimeUnavailable with the supplied message. The loader path throws it when a module lacks one or more required Harness JSON ABI exports.

outputs.name: WasmModuleRuntimeAdapter.invoke
outputs.description: Resolves to the module response envelope or a failure envelope for invalid JSON, invalid response text, timeout, or a runtime call failure. The deadline can expire while asynchronous loading yields; synchronous WebAssembly work cannot be interrupted and a result arriving after the deadline is discarded.

error.message: Wasm module does not export the Harness JSON ABI (memory, harness_alloc, harness_free, harness_invoke)

outputs.name: WasmModuleRuntimeAdapter.invokeText
outputs.description: Resolves to the raw response text returned through linear memory after the adapter encodes the request and frees both memory slices. It does not parse or validate the response; load, ABI, and memory failures reject the promise.

outputs.name: WasmModuleRuntimeAdapter.memoryBytes
outputs.description: Loads the module if needed and reports the current linear-memory buffer length in bytes. The promise rejects if loading fails or the memory export cannot be read.

outputs.name: WasmModuleRuntimeAdapter.close
outputs.description: Clears the cached instance promise so a later call loads the module again. It resolves immediately and does not interrupt work already in progress.

errors.name: RuntimeUnavailable
errors.description: The loader throws this named error when required Harness JSON ABI exports are missing; invokeText and memoryBytes reject with it, while invoke returns a runtime-unavailable failure envelope.

errors.name: CompileError
errors.description: WebAssembly.compile rejects when supplied bytes are not a valid module; raw methods reject with it, while invoke converts it to a runtime-unavailable failure envelope.

errors.name: LinkError
errors.description: WebAssembly.instantiate may reject when the module requires imports, because this adapter instantiates with an empty import object; invoke converts the call failure to runtime-failed.

errors.name: RuntimeError
errors.description: A trap in module initialization or an exported ABI call rejects the raw method; invoke converts call failures to runtime-failed.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: Malformed export values can fail when the adapter reads memory or calls an ABI export; invoke converts call failures to runtime-failed.

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: An invalid pointer or length can make a linear-memory view fail; invokeText rejects with that failure and invoke converts it to runtime-failed.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: A caller-provided loader can reject with its own Error, which raw methods propagate; invoke converts errors from the inner call to runtime-failed unless the error is RuntimeUnavailable or CompileError.
